scenarios.title: Checkout lists cart lines with correct line prices, subtotal and total
preconditions: Fresh session on / (cart is in memory, so do not load /checkout directly)
steps: Click 'Add Ceramic Mug to cart' twice and 'Add Canvas Tote to cart' once
Click the header nav link 'Checkout' (client-side navigation, not a URL load)
Read the 'Order items' list and the summary
expectedResults: h1 reads 'Checkout'
'Order items' list has 'Ceramic Mug × 2' with $36.00 and 'Canvas Tote × 1' with $24.00, each with a 'Remove' button
Subtotal (data-testid=subtotal) is $60.00
Total (data-testid=total) is $60.00
No Discount row is shown when no coupon is applied
scenarios.rationale: Core happy path and line and subtotal arithmetic.

scenarios.title: Valid coupon SAVE10 is applied and the discount is subtracted from the Total
preconditions: Add 'Ceramic Mug' once on /, then go to /checkout via the 'Checkout' nav link
expectedResults: Status message 'Coupon SAVE10 applied: 10% off' is shown
Subtotal is $18.00
Discount row (data-testid=discount) shows −$1.80 (U+2212 minus)
Total is $16.20 (subtotal minus discount). A Total that stays $18.00 is a defect: the code sets totalCents = subtotalCents so the discount is never subtracted
scenarios.rationale: Covers the flagged business-rule bug (discount shown but not deducted from Total) and case-insensitive coupon handling.

scenarios.title: WELCOME20 on a mixed cart and rounding on a single item give correct discount and Total
preconditions: Add Ceramic Mug, Canvas Tote and Dot Notebook once each on /, then go to /checkout via the 'Checkout' nav link
steps: Type 'WELCOME20' (with surrounding spaces, e.g. ' WELCOME20 ') in 'Coupon code' and click 'Apply'
Read the status, Subtotal, Discount and Total
Click 'Remove Ceramic Mug' and 'Remove Canvas Tote' so only Dot Notebook remains
Read Subtotal, Discount and Total again
expectedResults: Status 'Coupon WELCOME20 applied: 20% off' is shown (code trimmed and uppercased)
With all three items: Subtotal $54.00, Discount −$10.80, Total $43.20
After removal only Dot Notebook is left: the coupon stays applied and the discount is recalculated from the current subtotal: Subtotal $12.00, Discount −$2.40, Total $9.60
scenarios.rationale: Checks the second coupon, input trimming, discount recalculation when the cart changes, and Total arithmetic.

scenarios.title: Coupon validation errors: empty, whitespace-only and unknown codes
preconditions: Add 'Ceramic Mug' once on /, then go to /checkout via the 'Checkout' nav link
steps: With the 'Coupon code' field empty, click 'Apply'
Type 'SAVE10' and click 'Apply' and wait for success
Clear the field, type 'BOGUS' and click 'Apply' again
expectedResults: Empty and whitespace-only submit show the alert 'Enter a coupon code' with no Discount row
'BOGUS' shows the alert 'Invalid coupon code' with no Discount row
After a valid SAVE10, submitting 'BOGUS' replaces the success status with the alert 'Invalid coupon code' and the Discount row disappears
Total equals Subtotal ($18.00) whenever no coupon is active
scenarios.rationale: Covers form validation and error-state transitions, including replacing a previously applied coupon.

scenarios.title: Apply button shows a loading state while the coupon is validated
preconditions: Add 'Dot Notebook' on /, then go to /checkout via the 'Checkout' nav link
steps: Click 'Apply' and immediately inspect the button
Wait about 300ms and inspect the button again
expectedResults: During validation the button text is 'Applying…' and it is disabled (repeat clicks have no effect)
After validation the button returns to 'Apply' and is enabled
The success status 'Coupon SAVE10 applied: 10% off' appears once

scenarios.title: Removing lines updates totals and leads to the empty state with a way back
preconditions: Add 'Ceramic Mug' twice and 'Canvas Tote' once on /, then go to /checkout via the 'Checkout' nav link
expectedResults: After the first removal the whole Ceramic Mug line (both units) is gone, only 'Canvas Tote × 1' $24.00 remains, and Subtotal and Total are $24.00
After removing the last line, h1 'Your cart is empty', the text 'Add a product to start checking out.' and the link 'Browse products' are shown, and the coupon form and summary are not shown
Clicking 'Browse products' navigates to / (products list)
The header cart badge no longer counts the removed items
scenarios.rationale: Removal flow, cart badge sync and empty-state navigation.

scenarios.title: Direct load of /checkout shows the empty cart state
preconditions: No items added in the current session
expectedResults: h1 'Your cart is empty' and text 'Add a product to start checking out.' are shown
There is no coupon form, order summary or 'Place order' button
'Browse products' navigates to /
scenarios.rationale: Empty state for a fresh session; the cart lives in memory so a direct load is always empty.

scenarios.title: 'Place order' gives user feedback and completes the order
preconditions: Add 'Ceramic Mug' on /, then go to /checkout via the 'Checkout' nav link
expectedResults: The click performs an action: an order confirmation is shown or the user moves to a confirmation view, and the cart is cleared or the button shows a processing state
Silence is a defect. Source review shows 'Place order' has no onClick handler and is not inside a form, so nothing happens
scenarios.rationale: The primary call to action is a no-op; the test should catch this dead end in the checkout flow.

scenarios.title: Checkout heading, coupon controls and Place order button match Figma tokens
preconditions: Add 'Ceramic Mug' and 'Canvas Tote' on /, then go to /checkout via the 'Checkout' nav link
steps: Inspect the 'Coupon code' textbox and the 'Apply' button
Measure the width of the checkout column
expectedResults: h1 uses Heading/H1: Inter 700, 40px, line-height 48px
'Apply' is the Secondary button: white background, #0F172A text, 1px solid #E2E8F0 border, 8px radius, 44px height, 120px wide, Inter 600 16px
'Coupon code' textbox is 44px high
'Place order' is the Primary button: #2563EB background, #FFFFFF text, 8px radius, 44px height, no border, full width (560px)
Checkout column is 560px wide
scenarios.rationale: The Figma reference image for the Checkout screen was not rendered, so only observed Button, control-height, H1 and column-width tokens are checked.

scenarios.title: Checkout fits a 390px mobile viewport without horizontal overflow
preconditions: Add 'Ceramic Mug' twice and 'Canvas Tote' once on /, then reach /checkout through the 'Checkout' link (use the header menu button if the nav is collapsed)
steps: Check the page for horizontal scrolling
Inspect the order lines, coupon row, summary rows and 'Place order' button
Apply 'SAVE10' and check the layout again
expectedResults: The document has no horizontal scroll (scrollWidth <= 390)
Each order line shows its name, price and 'Remove' button without overlap or clipping
The 'Coupon code' textbox and 'Apply' button are visible and usable, with 44px control height, and stay within the viewport
Summary labels and right-aligned values are readable and not clipped, including the Discount row
'Place order' spans the content width, stays within the viewport and has a 44px tap height
Content keeps the 24px side gutters where the layout allows
scenarios.rationale: The design has no Checkout mobile frame, only Home mobile with 24px gutters and 44px controls. This checks that the 560px column and the grid rows (1fr auto auto) collapse well on small screens.
